title: Show their winger down the line
titleKid: Send their winger to the sideline
brief: Their #8 is about to play the ball out to their winger on your side.
briefKid: Their midfielder is about to pass to their winger near you.
question: Their winger has turned to face you on the touchline. Where do you go?
questionKid: Their winger has the ball and is facing you. Where do you go?

takeaway.standard: Press a winger from the inside: close them down goal-side with the middle shut, so the only way on is down the touchline.
takeaway.kid: Get close from the middle side, so they can only go down the line.

misconceptions.text: You pressed from the touchline side, which leaves the inside open for them to cut in toward our goal.
misconceptions.textKid: Coming from the side line lets them cut inside, so come from the middle side.

misconceptions.text: You held back, which gives their winger time to cross or run at you; close them down.
misconceptions.textKid: You are too far away, so get close before they run or pass.
